content.user_title: Optimize Azure Costs with Usage Evidence
content.value_statement: Azure cost reviews often miss orphaned resources and real utilization data. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through cost queries, metrics, pricing checks, and reports.
actual_capabilities: Checks required Azure CLI tools, azqr access, and Azure reader permissions before analysis.
Uses Azure Quick Review guidance to find orphaned resources and cost-impacting governance issues.
Builds Azure Cost Management REST queries for recent actual costs by resource.
Collects Azure Monitor utilization metrics for VMs, App Service plans, and storage accounts.
Validates savings assumptions against official Azure pricing pages and free tier notes.
Generates cost optimization reports and local audit trail files in the output folder.
limitations: Requires authenticated Azure CLI access and Azure roles that can read costs, metrics, and resources.
Does not deploy Azure resources, perform general diagnostics, or replace security review skills.
Savings estimates depend on accessible billing data, metrics coverage, and current pricing pages.
Destructive cleanup actions require explicit human approval, testing, and rollback planning.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Subscription Cost Review
use_cases.description: Collect actual spend, top resources, utilization metrics, and validated pricing for one Azure subscription.

use_cases.title: Find Redis Savings Opportunities
use_cases.description: Review Redis caches for failed deployments, oversized tiers, missing tags, and environment-specific downgrade options.

use_cases.title: Create an Executive Savings Report
use_cases.description: Summarize monthly and annual savings with evidence, priorities, implementation notes, and audit trail references.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Cost Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Azure cost optimization skill to review subscription <subscription id>. Check prerequisites, collect actual costs, and summarize top savings opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Resource Group
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Azure costs for subscription <subscription id> and resource group <resource group>. Include orphaned resources, utilization data, pricing validation, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Redis Costs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Redis-specific guidance to analyze Redis caches across <scope>. Identify failed caches, oversized tiers, dev or test waste, and tag gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Audit-Ready Savings Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an audit-ready Azure savings report for <scope>. Use actual Cost Management data, 14-day metrics, official pricing, risk priorities, and implementation safeguards.

output_examples.input: Review one production subscription for savings.
output: A prioritized savings report with actual monthly cost, top cost drivers, and evidence sources.
Orphaned resource findings from Azure Quick Review, marked by expected impact and approval needs.
Rightsizing recommendations backed by recent Azure Monitor metrics and pricing validation.

output_examples.input: Analyze Redis caches for a platform team.
output: A subscription-level Redis summary showing failed caches, oversized tiers, missing tags, and review priorities.
Detailed cache recommendations with estimated monthly savings and required approval steps.

output_examples.input: Create an executive report for FinOps review.
output: An executive summary with monthly and annual savings estimates.
A validation appendix listing cost query results, pricing sources, and metric evidence.

best_practices: Query actual Azure costs before estimating savings or ranking recommendations.
Validate pricing with official Azure pages and account for free tier allowances.
Save audit trail files and require approval before any cleanup or rightsizing action.
anti_patterns: Do not recommend deletions from scanner output without cost data and owner review.
Do not treat old or untagged resources as unused without operational validation.
Do not use stale pricing, unsupported date ranges, or broken Azure Portal links.

faq.question: What Azure access does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs Azure CLI authentication plus reader access for costs, monitoring metrics, and resources in the chosen scope.

faq.question: Does this skill change Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on analysis and reporting. Any cleanup or rightsizing action requires explicit human approval.

faq.question: Can it analyze Azure Redis costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Redis-specific rules for failed caches, oversized tiers, test environments, and missing lifecycle tags.

faq.question: Why does it save cost query results?
faq.answer: The saved results provide an audit trail that supports the recommendations and helps compare future savings.

faq.question: Can it estimate costs without billing access?
faq.answer: It can discuss patterns, but reliable recommendations require actual Cost Management data from Azure.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
